content:
# Missions Quick Reference

```
luuna-missions ready      # Find unblocked work
luuna-missions show <id> [id...] # View one or more issues
luuna-missions create --title "..." # Create issue (--type, --priority, --from)
luuna-missions update <id> --claim # Claim work (atomic)
luuna-missions close <id> # Complete work
luuna-missions dep add <a> <b> # a depends on b
luuna-missions plan prompt <seed> # Plan large/ambiguous work
luuna-missions sync       # Stage + commit .luuna/missions/
```

**Planning:** Use `luuna-missions plan` for ambiguous or large work — built-in templates: `feature`, `bug`, `refactor`.

**Before finishing:** `luuna-missions close <ids>`, run `go test ./...`, `luuna-missions sync`; push per repo conventions. Never hand-edit `.luuna/missions/*.jsonl`.
